facts.fact: FAO's WaPOR page says Gezira Scheme is a WaPOR pilot area in Sudan, with partners including the Ministry of Agriculture and Forests, the Agricultural Research Corporation and the Sudan Meteorological Authority, and lists a July 2024 report monitoring Gezira cropland with WaPOR satellite data.

SDN.note: WaPOR is an FAO portal; no Sudanese public body is said to publish data on it.
Research partners work on water productivity, not digital policy.
